== Notes ==
* Each of Barrage's arrows counts as a separate [[attack]]. Effects that trigger on attack/hit can trigger multiple times; however, some skills have no effect, or only affect the first arrow.
** If Barrage is combined with Paragon shouts or chants that apply conditions or damage boosts such as [[Anthem of Flame]] or [["Find Their Weakness!"]], the condition and/or bonus damage will be applied randomly to one of the foes hit by Barrage rather than all of them.
* Barrage can be used to maintain [[List of adrenal skills|adrenaline skills]], since each arrow that hits will provide one strike of [[adrenaline]]. 
* Since the extra arrows are fired at foes adjacent to your target, always try to target an enemy in the middle of a large group.
* Combine with [[Splinter Weapon]] for a large [[area of effect]] [[spike]].

== Trivia ==

* This is one of five (nine in {{reforgedmode}}) elite skills seen in [[pre-Searing Ascalon]], where it is used by [[Vatlaaw Doomtooth]]. The other four are [[Hundred Blades]], [[Bull's Charge]], [[Earth Shaker]], and [[Ward Against Harm]] (with [["Victory Is Mine!"]], [[Greater Conflagration]], [[Plague Signet]], and [[Elemental Attunement]] in Reforged).
